outputs.explanation: Panel A is a set of micrographs; it contains no plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel B includes two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing mean values with error bars (n=20) but no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D includes two bar charts (SDH and COX signal intensity) showing mean values with error bars and sample sizes noted, but individual data points are not overlaid on the bars.

Panel E shows FACS histograms (cell number vs. TMRM intensity), which display full distributions of individual events rather than averaged summary statistics, so individual point overlay is not applicable.
